Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re a team focused on making frontier AI models better at science. LLMs know an extraordinary amount of biology, but there’s still a large gap in reasoning for the real-world problems scientists face every day. We recently published some of our work here https://www.benchling.com/blog/can-llms-work-in-the-wet-lab.

You’ll build the datasets, evaluations, and systems that help close that gap. You’ll work with scientists to turn complex scientific work into rigorous tasks that models can learn from and be evaluated against. You’ll partner with leading AI labs to understand where models fail and how to improve them.

This is an early and rapidly evolving area. You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, biology, and frontier AI: finding tasks that are challenging for LLMs and valuable to scientists, designing evaluations that capture real scientific judgment, and building systems to create these tasks at scale.

- Collaborate with frontier AI labs, helping develop and evaluate new approaches for improving models on challenging scientific tasks.

- Work closely with scientists, translating expert judgment into problems and evaluation criteria that can reliably distinguish strong model behavior.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years at the intersection of biology and AI, with academic or industry experience evaluating and improving scientific models or LLMs for biological applications.

- Experience building with LLMs, with an intuition for where current models excel, where they struggle, and how to design systems around their capabilities.

- Curiosity and excitement about frontier AI, with a desire to understand and push the capabilities of rapidly improving models.

- Comfort working on ambiguous problems, where the playing field is rapidly shifting and the right technical approaches are still being discovered.

- Collaborative mindset, able to work closely with engineers, scientists, and external research partners.

- Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift and rapid experimentation is encouraged.

 

HOW WE WORK

We prioritize in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 5 days per week (Monday - Friday).

title: Payment Operations Team Lead
description:
Location: México/Remote
Type: Contractor, full-time.
About The Role
Ottimate is seeking a highly organized and proactive Payment Operations Team Lead to provide day-to-day leadership for the Payment Operations Analyst team. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence by coaching analysts, managing daily workflows, reinforcing policies and procedures, and ensuring exceptional service for our customers.
Working closely with the Payment Operations Manager, the Team Lead serves as the operational heartbeat of the team-balancing workload, removing obstacles, monitoring performance, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. This is a working leadership role that combines hands-on operational support with team coaching and execution.
Team Leadership & Coaching

• Provide day-to-day leadership and guidance to the Payment Operations Analyst team.

• Monitor workloads and ensure resources are allocated effectively.

• Conduct regular coaching sessions focused on performance, communication, and customer experience.

• Reinforce company policies, operational standards, and best practices.

• Identify performance gaps and partner with the Payment Operations Manager on development plans.

• Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Support onboarding and training of new Payment Operations Analysts to ensure successful ramp-up and adherence to operational standards.

Operational Excellence

• Monitor queues, service levels, and workload distribution throughout the day.

• Ensure payment inquiries are handled accurately and within established service expectations.

• Review aging work items and proactively remove operational bottlenecks.

• Support analysts with complex customer situations while encouraging ownership and development.

• Drive consistency in processes and execution across the team.

• Serve as an escalation point for complex customer, operational, and payment-related issues.

• Maintain and contribute to operational documentation, SOPs, and team knowledge resources.

Quality & Performance Management

• Conduct quality reviews of customer interactions and provide actionable feedback.

• Track key operational metrics including CSAT, response times, resolution times, backlog, and productivity.

• Identify trends impacting customer experience and recommend improvements.

• Celebrate high performance while addressing opportunities for improvement in a timely manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Payment Operations Manager to execute departmental priorities and initiatives.

• Work closely with the Payment Solutions & Enablement Specialist to ensure analysts have the knowledge and tools needed to support customers effectively.

• Collaborate with Customer Success, Product, and Engineering when operational issues require coordination.

• Support implementation of new processes, tools, and payment capabilities.

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in payment operations, customer operations, fintech, or a related field.

• Previous experience leading, mentoring, or coaching team members in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong understanding of Virtual Card, ACH, and Check payment workflows.

• Demonstrated ability to hold others accountable while building positive working relationships.

• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics to drive team performance.

• Exceptional communication and conflict resolution skills.

• Passion for developing people and creating a high-performing team culture.
